description: Non-member explicit prior consent to receive ossekai @mention on a defined topic category. Revocable any time via unsubscribeRecord OR AT Proto native block/mute (G15). G6 STRUCTURAL: consent is opt-in (no pre-checked-by-default); per-category granularity; finite duration (≤365 days default; re-consent required after expiry).

consentingHandle.description: AT Proto handle of the consenting non-member

consentingDid.description: AT Proto DID of the consenting non-member

consentedCategories.description: G6 STRUCTURAL: per-category granularity; consent for category X does NOT imply consent for category Y

consentMethod.description: How consent was obtained; at-proto-public-reply-signed is the canonical path (consent is itself a public AT Proto record); council-attested-on-behalf-of-public-figure is reserved for public officials in their public capacity (e.g., elected representative consenting to civic-participation category) and requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 secondary attestation

consentDocumentCid.description: IPFS CID of the consent record (the signed reply / message / PDS record)

expiresAtUtc.description: G6 STRUCTURAL: default ≤365 days from createdAt; re-consent required after expiry; no perpetual consent allowed

revokedAtUtc.description: Revocation timestamp; consent_registry checks this BEFORE every dispatch

councilSecondaryAttestationDids.description: Required if consentMethod = council-attested-on-behalf-of-public-figure; ≥3 Council Lv6+ DIDs
